title: GridForge Spreadsheet - Harbor Task QC
subtitle: Main task folder QC while Oracle-02 is running
note: Scope excludes model job submissions except for prior Oracle evidence. Generated after removing internal CONTEXT.md from the upload zip and fixing executable archive modes.

runs.note: Completed before formula-caret fix; failed 4 formula interaction verifiers.
Model app exposed broken multi-character typing; useful discrimination evidence.

tasks.name: GridForge
tasks.headline: Static QC found one P0 packaging leak and fixed it; no open static P0 remains, but Oracle-02 must confirm golden score 1.0.

findings.what: The upload archive included internal handoff material: `CONTEXT.md`.
findings.why: The file contains development context, verifier strategy, run outcomes, and task-construction notes. Shipping it risks leaking rubric intent and model-breaking strategy to the graded environment or reviewers.
findings.impact: If agent-visible, this corrupts the training signal; even if not agent-visible, it is embarrassing internal material in a client artifact.
findings.fix: Rebuilt `gridforge-spreadsheet.zip` excluding `CONTEXT.md` and other internal/runtime files.
findings.action: Use the current rebuilt zip. Do not manually zip the whole folder because the root still keeps CONTEXT.md for our handoff.

findings.what: The previous zip had shell scripts recorded as non-executable (`0o666`).
findings.why: Harbor often invokes scripts through shell wrappers, but uploaded archives should preserve executable bits for `solution/solve.sh` and `tests/test.sh` to avoid platform-specific launch failures.
findings.impact: Could cause a build/test launch failure on a runner that executes scripts directly from archive permissions.
findings.fix: Rebuilt the zip with `solution/solve.sh` and `tests/test.sh` set to `0o755` in the central directory.
findings.action: Use the current rebuilt zip; archive check now reports both scripts executable.

findings.what: Oracle-01 scored `0.6111`, failing formula-bar/reference interaction verifiers.
findings.why: An Oracle below 1.0 means the task is not yet proven solvable. The run showed stale caret/reference state corrupting formulas after function suggestion or grid reference clicks.
findings.impact: Would block delivery if still present because the golden fails its own rubric.
findings.fix: Patched `app.js` to sync the live formula bar selection before grid reference insertion and to update stored caret state after function suggestion completion.
findings.action: Wait for Oracle-02. Mark closed only if Oracle-02 reaches 1.0; otherwise inspect remaining failed criteria.

findings.what: Rubric previously expected seed values `B2=120` and `C2=3`, but the seed file has `B2=3` and `C2=120`.
findings.why: A verifier asserting the wrong seed values makes Oracle fail a correct golden and punishes models for following the actual seed data.
findings.impact: Would block Oracle and corrupt scores for a purely task-authoring mistake.
findings.fix: Updated both active rubric criteria to expect `B2=3`, `C2=120`, and `D2=360`.
findings.action: No further action unless Oracle-02 reports the same mismatch.

findings.what: The local development folder contains runtime SQLite data directories, but the upload zip excludes them.
findings.why: Runtime DB files can confuse local manual testing and should never ship, but current archive hygiene is clean.
findings.impact: Local-only risk: testers may see stale/blank data if they run without `RESET_SEED=1`; no current upload impact.
findings.fix: Patched `db.js` reset to delete `gridforge.db`, `gridforge.db-wal`, and `gridforge.db-shm`; rebuilt zip excluding `data` and `data-*` directories.
findings.action: Run local app with `RESET_SEED=1` and correct `SEED_PATH`; upload only the filtered zip.

blocks.title: Ship-blockers
items: No open static packaging P0 remains after rebuilding the zip without CONTEXT.md and with executable script modes.
Oracle-02 is still pending. If Oracle-02 is below 1.0, that becomes the active P0 to fix before upload.

blocks.title: Clean Checks
items: Active rubric parses with 20 unique criteria and total weight 18.0.
Weights are within the requested 0.5 to 2.0 range.
Current zip contains 18 files, excludes node_modules/data/db/log/pyc/internal CONTEXT.md, and records solve.sh/test.sh as 0o755.
No real API keys or secrets found in the main task folder scan; only environment-variable placeholders are present.
